name: Hangzhou Changchuan Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Hangzhou Changchuan Technology Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, researches and develops, produces, and sells integrated circuit equipment in China and internationally. It offers testing equipment for integrated circuit packaging and testing companies, wafer manufacturing companies, and chip design companies.
